scenarios.name: Summer Reception
scenarios.description: The residence opens its state rooms and garden terrace for an evening reception.

patches.description: Carriages arrive in the Court of Honour while attendants guide guests to the entrance portico.
The ballroom is prepared for music, dancing and access to the garden terrace.

steps.name: Guest Arrival
steps.description: Guests enter through the Columned Vestibule and are received in the state rooms.

patches.description: Footmen receive invitations and direct guests to the cloakroom and salons.

steps.name: State Dinner
steps.description: The company moves to the State Dining Room.

patches.description: The table is laid for the formal dinner while service enters from the Butler's Pantry.

steps.name: Garden Ball
steps.description: The ballroom and garden terrace become the centre of the evening.

patches.description: Lanterns illuminate the terrace and guests may walk into the formal garden.

scenarios.name: Night Watch
scenarios.description: After the household retires, the estate is secured and the guards begin their final patrol.

patches.description: The Court of Honour is closed to visitors after the final carriage departs.
The stable doors are closed after the evening feed.

steps.name: Secure the Archive
steps.description: The steward checks the Archive and Map Room before handing over to the night watch.

patches.description: The archive door is locked and only registered key holders may enter.

steps.name: Final Patrol
steps.description: The steward checks both gatehouses and the Court of Honour.

patches.description: The east gatehouse remains closed until dawn.

intentions.text: During the Summer Reception, an invited guest should be able to travel from the Court of Honour to the Ballroom and Garden Salon.
Domestic staff should reach the State Dining Room through the Butler's Pantry without crossing the Columned Vestibule.
Stable staff should be able to move between the Stable Yard and Horse Paddock without entering the public state-room zone.

evidence.text: The estate plan aligns the main entrance, Court of Honour, palace vestibule, garden salon and central garden avenue.
The palace plan places the kitchen, pantry and table-service rooms beside the service circulation leading to the State Dining Room.
The two gatehouses flank the entrance and support a guarded arrival route into the Court of Honour.
